tei:div.tei:p: Master of the world! May it be thy will, Lord our God and

God of our fathers, to remember in our favor the covenant of our fathers. Even as Abraham our father held back his compassion from his only son and desired to slay him in order to do thy will, so may thy mercy hold back thy anger from us; let thy compassion prevail over thy acts of retaliation. Be lenient with us, Lord our God, and deal with us kindly and mercifully. In thy great goodness, may thy fierce wrath turn away from thy people, thy city, thy land, and thy heritage. Fulfill, Lord our God, what thou hast promised us through Moses thy servant, as it is said: “I will remember my covenant with Jacob; also my covenant with Isaac and my covenant with Abraham will I remember; and I will remember the land.”
